The '''''Razor''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Razor'' was stationed in the [[Tallaan system/Legends|Tallaan system]], guarding the [[Tallaani Shipyards]].<ref name="BH" />
